newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen Central Bank announces t-bills results.
newsitem.headline: Yemen Central Bank announces t-bills results.

text.p: Yemen's Central Bank on Sunday said its latest issue of 91-day treasury bills yielded an average of 12.83 percent, down from the average 13.49 percent at the May 25 auction.
Of the three billion rials worth of bills on offer, the issue attracted 2.85 billion rials.
The average price was 9,690.04 and the lowest price accepted was 9,665.00 rials. Yields ranged between 11.34 percent and 13.90 percent.

The latest issue of 182-day bills yielded an average of 12.59 percent from 13.23 percent at the previous auction. Of the one billion rials worth of bills on offer, the issue attracted 788 million rials.
The average price was 9,409.36 and the lowest accepted price was 9,375.00. Yields ranged between 11.67 percent and 13.27 percent.

The latest issue of 364-day bills yielded an average of 13.19 percent from 13.59 percent at the previous auction. Of the 500 million rials worth of 364-day treasury bills on offer, the issue attracted bids totalling 450 million rials. The average price was 8,837.75 rials and the lowest accepted price was 8,752.00 rials. Yields ranged between 12.50 percent and 14.30 percent.
